node --check extract.js && node extract.js /app/a.out > out.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,struct
d=json.load(open('/app/out.json'))
print('entries',len(d))
vals=list(d.values())
print('min/max',min(vals),max(vals))
print('any >=2^31',any(v>=2**31 for v in vals))
# recompute full unsigned segment reference
buf=open('/app/a.out','rb').read()
phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,0x20)[0]; es=struct.unpack_from('<H',buf,0x36)[0]; n=struct.unpack_from('<H',buf,0x38)[0]
ref={}
for i in range(n):
    o=phoff+i*es
    if struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,o)[0]!=1: continue
    off=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,o+8)[0]; va=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,o+16)[0]
    fsz=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,o+32)[0]; msz=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,o+40)[0]
    for j in range(0,min(fsz,msz)-3,4):
        ref[str(va+j)]=struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,off+j)[0]
# recall over ref excluding addr 0 (which we deliberately skip)
common=set(d)&set(ref)
wrong=[k for k in common if d[k]!=ref[k]]
print('common',len(common),'wrong',len(wrong))
print('recall over full ref',len(common)/len(ref), 'over ref minus addr0', len(common)/(len(ref)-1))
print('subset of ref?', set(d)<=set(ref))
EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
import struct
buf=open('/app/a.out','rb').read()
# section headers ELF64
shoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',buf,0x28)[0]; shentsize=struct.unpack_from('<H',buf,0x3a)[0]
shnum=struct.unpack_from('<H',buf,0x3c)[0]; shstrndx=struct.unpack_from('<H',buf,0x3e)[0]
secs=[]
for i in range(shnum):
    o=shoff+i*shentsize
    name,typ,flags,addr,off,size,link,info,align,entsize=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQIIQQ',buf,o)
    secs.append((name,typ,flags,addr,off,size))
# shstrtab names
shstr=secs[shstrndx]
strtab=buf[shstr[4]:shstr[4]+shstr[5]]
def nm(n):
    e=strtab.find(b'\0',n); return strtab[n:e].decode()
tot=hi=0
per={}
for (name,typ,flags,addr,off,size) in secs:
    n=nm(name)
    if not (flags & 0x2): continue  # SHF_ALLOC
    if typ==8: continue # NOBITS
    cnt=h=0
    for j in range(0,size-3,4):
        v=struct.unpack_from('<I',buf,off+j)[0]; cnt+=1; h+=v>=2**31
    per[n]=(cnt,h)
    tot+=cnt; hi+=h
print('alloc sections words',tot,'high',hi,'frac',hi/tot)
for k,v in per.items(): print(k,v)
print('text frac')
EOF
